svg.title: dsh-hidden-risk-map — ledger rows to candidate clauses
svg.desc: Seven ledger rows against seven outcomes. Rows map through literal keywords to industry clauses; article 2 reroutes regime rows; unmatched rows stay in the gap column as HR-001 findings. The rule-state rail and the two report exits follow.
